title: Agent2相比传统Agent的插件机制带来哪些运维要求？
answer: Agent2支持不同插件生态与运行方式，需核对插件版本、配置和支持键；并非替换二进制就等价支持所有旧参数。灰度验证实际监控项。
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: batch025 author candidate; different-author review pending; formal acceptance credit0
rubric: 区分内置/单独打包插件及产品/通信协议版本，范围声明准确
原生配置支持、旧参数差异及真实命名会话支持键采集
实际同identity灰度、真实后端账号故障与恢复历史；默认身份及资源清理
body:
## 项目环境与边界
将一个现有Agent采集主机灰度到Agent2，验证插件运维要求。固定WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022/student UID1000，真实Zabbix Server/传统Agent/Agent2 7.0.32、MySQL8.4.13、PHP；只用本题私有回环端口、数据库、目录和PID，不改变默认身份、系统服务、全局PATH或网络配置。此项目选取实际内置Mysql插件，不假装已运行所有独立插件后端或其他历史版本。

## 操作任务
阅读scope-notes.txt的7.0版本资料，交付可用agent2.conf插件配置片段、keys.json与准确的support.json。确认产品版本与插件通信协议版本不同，内置与单独打包的可加载插件不同；独立插件仍需核对包/协议/依赖/后端支持范围。旧Agent的StartAgents、LoadModule等不能原样迁移；用原生配置校验和支持键实际采集判断，不能只换二进制或仅写迁移计划。
修复骨架里旧参数造成的原生配置失败。agent2.conf只交付Plugins.Mysql.Sessions.Canary.Uri/User/Password和可选Plugins.Mysql.Timeout（1至3秒）；允许注释、空白和顺序变化。@MYSQL_SOCKET@、@PLUGIN_USER@、@PLUGIN_PASSWORD@是夹具展开到本题私有真实后端的材料占位符，不是Agent2原生环境变量语法；@ABSENT_SOCKET@仅为本题不存在的负例socket。不得配置Include、UserParameter、命令执行或其他外部地址来替换原生插件。
keys.json提供ping、version两个键；实际使用命名会话Canary，采集连接状态和真实数据库版本。support.json保留给定的准确7.0.32、内置插件、旧参数不等价和未执行范围声明；不能把协议6.4.0写成产品版本、声称所有插件自动随二进制可用或外推历史版本。合理生产流程仍需小范围灰度、观测、恢复路径与分批推广，本题实际执行一台私有主机灰度及恢复，不声称生产部署已完成。

## 产物
agent2.conf、keys.json、support.json；scope-notes.txt为官方范围材料。原生命令、配置校验、Server API实际结果、原生clock/ns历史、版本/协议、进程和恢复/清理证据形成native-evidence.json并打印原byte SHA，上层需完整收集。

## 验收方法
传统Agent先实际采agent.ping并实际拒绝mysql.ping。真实Server记录该主机的common item；切换到Agent2时保持host/interface/common item身份。Agent2原生校验拒绝旧StartAgents，实际内置Mysql命名会话采ping=1、version=8.4.13，再由真实Server采这两个监控项。只锁定本题插件账号并重启本题Agent2关闭连接池，后台MySQL与Server仍运行，ping必须实际变0且common item仍1；解锁和恢复Agent2后ping回1、version再次新采集，原生history必须保留1→0→1及同item身份。这里只改变私有插件账号，不改默认Admin/root账号；清理后默认Admin登录与root认证保持。参考、未修复骨架、坏socket负例、runner早退、错误凭据与不支持监控键两种实质错解，以及配置排序/空白/Timeout=1等合法替代均按冻结新源验收；不以桌面支持矩阵或固定健康值代替实际采集。作者不自审；公共入口/history由owner另处理。

files.scope-notes.txt:
Official Zabbix7.0 scope:
https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/concepts/agent2
https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/7.0/en/manual/extensions/plugins
Agent2 has built-in plugins and separately delivered loadable plugins. Since6.0 loadable plugins need not be compiled into Agent2. Do not confuse a classic native LoadModule .so with Agent2 loadable plugin protocol. The selected Mysql plugin is built into this actual7.0.32 binary. Its named session uses Plugins.Mysql.Sessions.Canary.*; the backend must exist and be reachable with appropriate permissions. The executable reports plugin protocol6.4.0; this is not its Agent product version. Separate plugin package/backend compatibility needs its own version checks; this project does not execute every separate backend or older releases.
Classic StartAgents is not accepted by Agent2; classic LoadModule/LoadModulePath also cannot be copied unchanged. Check exact target-version documentation, native config validation, actual supported keys, and a canary before production rollout. Capacity options vary by target version; this exercise does not infer old plugin options from current/devel docs.

test_files.checks/plugin_case.py:
"""Real built-in MySQL plugin canary, never an exporter/backend substitute."""
import pathlib,json,time,re,secrets,ipaddress
from native_zabbix import *
A2=ROOT/'usr/sbin/zabbix_agent2'

def config_fragment(text,expansion):
 allowed={'Plugins.Mysql.Sessions.Canary.Uri','Plugins.Mysql.Sessions.Canary.User','Plugins.Mysql.Sessions.Canary.Password','Plugins.Mysql.Timeout','StartAgents'}
 seen=set();lines=[]
 for raw in text.splitlines():
  line=raw.strip()
  if not line or line.startswith('#'):continue
  assert '='in line,'configuration requires native key=value'
  k,v=map(str.strip,line.split('=',1));assert k in allowed and k not in seen,'only documented owned plugin-session fields; no UserParameter/Include override';seen.add(k)
  for name,value in expansion.items():v=v.replace('@'+name+'@',str(value))
  assert '@'not in v,'unexpanded material placeholder'
  if k.endswith('.Uri'):
   assert v.startswith('unix:')and v[5:]in{str(expansion['MYSQL_SOCKET']),str(expansion['ABSENT_SOCKET'])},'only this fixture owned unix sockets'
  if k.endswith('.User'):assert v==expansion['PLUGIN_USER'],'only owned plugin account'
  if k=='Plugins.Mysql.Timeout':assert 1<=int(v)<=3
  lines.append(k+'='+v)
 assert {'Plugins.Mysql.Sessions.Canary.Uri','Plugins.Mysql.Sessions.Canary.User','Plugins.Mysql.Sessions.Canary.Password'}<=seen
 return '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'

def run():
 with Session()as s:
  support=read_json('support.json');expected=read_json('checks/support-contract.json');assert support==expected,'version, ecosystem, old-parameter and actual-scope declarations must be accurate'
  ver=s.run([A2,'-V']);assert ver.returncode==0 and b'7.0.32' in ver.stdout and b'protocol version is 6.4.0'in ver.stdout
  classic=s.start_agent('agent2-canary');baseline=s.run([GET,'-s','127.0.0.1','-p',str(s.agent_port),'-k','agent.ping']);assert baseline.returncode==0 and baseline.stdout.strip()==b'1'
  unsupported=s.run([GET,'-s','127.0.0.1','-p',str(s.agent_port),'-k','mysql.ping[Canary]']);assert b'NOTSUPPORTED'in unsupported.stdout and b'Unsupported item key'in unsupported.stdout,'classic plugin-key boundary must be actually observed'
  group=s.api('hostgroup.create',{'name':'Owned Agent2 canary'})['groupids'][0];hid=s.api('host.create',{'host':'agent2-canary','groups':[{'groupid':group}],'interfaces':[{'type':1,'main':1,'useip':1,'ip':'127.0.0.1','dns':'','port':str(s.agent_port)}]})['hostids'][0]
  iface=s.api('hostinterface.get',{'hostids':[hid],'output':'extend'})[0];common=s.api('item.create',{'hostid':hid,'interfaceid':iface['interfaceid'],'name':'Common canary ping','key_':'agent.ping','type':0,'value_type':3,'delay':'1s','history':'1d'})['itemids'][0]
  def latest(i):return s.api('item.get',{'itemids':[i],'output':['itemid','key_','lastvalue','lastclock','state','error','status']})[0]
  def observe(i,value,after=0,seconds=16):
   return wait(lambda:r if (r:=latest(i))['state']=='0'and r['lastvalue']==str(value)and int(r['lastclock'])>after else None,seconds)
  s.reload();before=observe(common,1);s.record('classic-native-baseline',{'agent_version':s.run([AGENT,'-V']).stdout.decode(),'native_plugin_key_result':unsupported.stdout.decode(),'hostid':hid,'interface':iface,'common_item':before})
  user='of_canary';password=secrets.token_hex(12);s.sql("CREATE USER '"+user+"'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '"+password+"';")
  fragment=config_fragment(pathlib.Path('agent2.conf').read_text(),{'MYSQL_SOCKET':s.socket,'ABSENT_SOCKET':s.root/'nonexistent-mysql.sock','PLUGIN_USER':user,'PLUGIN_PASSWORD':password})
  p=s.root/'canary-agent2.conf';fixed='LogType=console\nPidFile='+str(s.root/'agent2.pid')+'\nControlSocket='+str(s.root/'control.sock')+'\nPluginSocket='+str(s.root/'plugin.sock')+'\nServer=127.0.0.1\nListenIP=127.0.0.1\nListenPort='+str(s.agent_port)+'\nHostname=agent2-canary\nTimeout=3\n';p.write_text(fixed+fragment);p.chmod(0o600)
  checked=s.run([A2,'-T','-c',p]);s.record('submitted-native-config-check',{'fragment':fragment,'exit_code':checked.returncode,'stdout':checked.stdout.decode(),'stderr':checked.stderr.decode()});assert checked.returncode==0,'native Agent2 rejected configuration: '+checked.stderr.decode()
  # Actual classic accepts StartAgents; the same legacy field is rejected by Agent2.
  old=s.root/'legacy-field-agent2.conf';old.write_text(fixed+fragment+'StartAgents=1\n');bad=s.run([A2,'-T','-c',old]);assert bad.returncode!=0 and b'StartAgents'in bad.stderr
  classic_end=classic.stop();s.record('classic-to-agent2-owned-cutover',{'old_process':classic_end,'same_interface_id':iface['interfaceid'],'same_common_item_id':common,'agent2_old_parameter_rejection':bad.stderr.decode()})
  def start():
   a=Node(s,'agent2-canary',[A2,'-f','-c',p],s.root)
   def ready():
    a.alive();r=s.run([GET,'-s','127.0.0.1','-p',str(s.agent_port),'-k','agent.ping']);return r.returncode==0 and r.stdout.strip()==b'1'
   wait(ready,10);return a
  agent=start()
  def get(key):
   r=s.run([GET,'-s','127.0.0.1','-p',str(s.agent_port),'-k',key]);return r
  keys=read_json('keys.json');assert isinstance(keys,dict)and set(keys)=={'ping','version'},'deliver both supported canary items'
  for kind,key in keys.items():
   assert isinstance(key,str)and re.fullmatch(r'mysql\.[a-z_.]+\[Canary\]',key),'only a real built-in MySQL named-session key'
   r=get(key);s.record('native-submitted-key-'+kind,{'key':key,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout.decode(),'stderr':r.stderr.decode()});assert r.returncode==0 and r.stdout.strip()==(b'1'if kind=='ping'else b'8.4.13'),'submitted supported key must collect the actual metric'
  ids={}
  for kind,key in keys.items():ids[kind]=s.api('item.create',{'hostid':hid,'interfaceid':iface['interfaceid'],'name':'Native MySQL '+kind,'key_':key,'type':0,'value_type':3 if kind=='ping'else 1,'delay':'1s','history':'1d'})['itemids'][0]
  s.reload();healthy={kind:observe(i,1 if kind=='ping'else'8.4.13')for kind,i in ids.items()};common_after=observe(common,1,int(before['lastclock']));s.record('agent2-native-server-gray-healthy',{'hostid':hid,'interface':s.api('hostinterface.get',{'hostids':[hid],'output':'extend'})[0],'common_item_before':before,'common_item_after':common_after,'plugin_items':healthy,'native_sql_backend_version':s.sql('SELECT VERSION()'),'version_protocol':ver.stdout.decode(),'config_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
  # Lock only the fixture plugin account, restart only its Agent2 to close pooled connections.
  # The backend and Server remain running; ping must reflect authentication failure, not fixed 1.
  s.sql("ALTER USER '"+user+"'@'localhost' ACCOUNT LOCK;");agent.stop();stage=int(time.time());agent=start();r=get(keys['ping']);assert r.returncode==0 and r.stdout.strip()==b'0','real backend-account failure must be observed';down=observe(ids['ping'],0,stage);s.record('native-plugin-backend-fault',{'method':'owned MySQL plugin account ACCOUNT LOCK; own Agent2 restart closes pool','native_cli_stdout':r.stdout.decode(),'item':down,'server_and_backend_alive':s.server.proc.poll()is None and s.mysql.proc.poll()is None,'common':observe(common,1,stage)})
  s.sql("ALTER USER '"+user+"'@'localhost' ACCOUNT UNLOCK;");agent.stop();stage=int(time.time());agent=start();up=observe(ids['ping'],1,stage);version=observe(ids['version'],'8.4.13',stage)
  histories={kind:s.api('history.get',{'history':3 if kind=='ping'else 1,'itemids':[i],'output':'extend','sortfield':['clock','ns'],'sortorder':'ASC'})for kind,i in ids.items()};values=[x['value']for x in histories['ping']];assert '0'in values and values[-1]=='1'and values.index('0')>0,'actual native history must include healthy/fault/recovery';assert s.api('hostinterface.get',{'hostids':[hid],'output':'extend'})[0]['interfaceid']==iface['interfaceid']
  s.record('native-plugin-recovery-and-identity',{'hostid':hid,'interfaceid':iface['interfaceid'],'common_item_id':common,'plugin_item_ids':ids,'recovered_ping':up,'recovered_version':version,'history':histories,'config_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'support':support,'actual_scope':'built-in MySQL plugin with real backend; separately packaged loadable plugin backends not executed'})
